question: A man spends 28% of his monthly salary on house rent. If every month, he also spends ₹687 on conveyance and ₹7,483 on grocery and saves the remaining ₹218, his monthly salary is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Remaining percentage after **house rent** = 100% − 28% = 72%.

Value of this 72% = **Conveyance** + **Grocery** + **Savings**.

72% of **Salary** = ₹687 + ₹7,483 + ₹218 = ₹8,388.

100% (Total Salary) = (8388 ÷ 72) × 100 = 116.5 × 100 = ₹11,650.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹11,650.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f6971bd40939597a9747ff49f6e27efce7de2e1b355a5266e1b34c549ff5517.png] 

**Given:**

**House Rent** = 28% of **Monthly Salary**

**Conveyance** = ₹687

**Grocery** = ₹7,483

**Savings** = ₹218

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total spending (excluding rent) and savings = ₹687 + ₹7,483 + ₹218

⇒ Total non-rent amount = ₹8,388

⇒ Percentage of salary excluding rent = 100% − 28% = 72%

⇒ 72% of **Monthly Salary** = ₹8,388

⇒ 1% of **Monthly Salary** = 8388 ÷ 72 = ₹116.5

⇒ 100% of **Monthly Salary** = 116.5 × 100 = ₹11,650

**∴ The correct answer is ₹11,650.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Base Change

When a value is divided into multiple components, the sum of all components in percentage must equal 100% of the base value.

Net Savings Calculation

**Income** = **Expenditure** + **Savings**. If expenditure is given as a mix of percentage and absolute values, always group absolute values first.
